info.title: > nugetz — A modern CLI for NuGet packages
info.description: Repository-aware NuGet audits, upgrade plans, package validation, search, installation, and safer publishing for .NET teams.

commands.name: advisories
commands.description:
upgrade       [package]  Preview or apply repository package updates
validate      [package]  Pack and validate a package without publishing
publish       [project]  Pack and publish to nuget.org
apikey        <sub>       Manage NuGet API key (set|remove|status)
